temporal_state_chain.observed: Elizabeth tells Keith that she is not upset with him; she is dealing with personal stuff and apologizes if she seemed short.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Keith believed Elizabeth might be upset with him because she had been unusually curt, possibly due to a misunderstanding or an unknown mistake.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Changed: Elizabeth's explanation disconfirms his suspicion that she was angry with him; her curtness is due to personal stress instead.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Keith believes Elizabeth is not upset with him and is dealing with personal stress.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Be understanding about her curtness and remain open to supporting her with her personal stress.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Elizabeth accepts Keith's offer of support and a coffee break, thanking him and saying it sounds good.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Keith believes Elizabeth is not upset with him and is dealing with personal stress.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Changed: Elizabeth is receptive to his support and agrees to a coffee break.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Keith believes Elizabeth welcomes his support and is willing to spend time talking over coffee.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Offer support by listening to her and having a coffee break together.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Over coffee, Elizabeth shares more about severe personal stresses. When Keith suggests professional help, she says she has thought about it but is hesitant and unsure.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Keith believes Elizabeth is dealing with personal stress and welcomes his support through a coffee break.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Changed: Her stresses seem severe; professional help might benefit her, but she is hesitant, and Keith worries about offending her.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Keith believes Elizabeth may need professional help and is hesitant about seeking it; he must be careful not to offend her.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Support her and encourage professional help gently while respecting her hesitation.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Keith notices Elizabeth become slightly withdrawn after his suggestion, but she tells him he did not overstep and that she appreciates his concern; it is just a lot to think about.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Keith believes Elizabeth may need professional help and is hesitant; he worries his suggestion might offend or embarrass her.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Changed: He initially interprets her withdrawal as possible embarrassment, but her reassurance changes this; she says he did not overstep and appreciates his concern.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Keith believes his suggestion did not offend Elizabeth; she appreciates his support and is still processing heavy concerns.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Regretful and worried, then reassured but still concerned.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Reassure her that he is supportive and avoid overstepping while continuing to be available.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Elizabeth seems more open and appreciative; she says Keith's support means a lot and that she feels better knowing she has it.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Keith believes his suggestion did not offend Elizabeth; she appreciates his support but is processing a lot.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Changed/confirmed: Elizabeth values his support, feels more comfortable around him, and feels better because of his concern.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Keith believes Elizabeth values his support and feels more comfortable with him; their supportive relationship is positive.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Maintain the supportive relationship and remain available for chats or breaks together.
